# `space`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
space(n)
```

Returns a string consisting of `n` spaces.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- space, example 1
> SELECT concat(space(2), '1');
```
